messages.content: You merge contract clauses.

You are resolving a clause conflict.
Return reasoning and merged clause text.
Format exactly:
REASONING:
<short reasoning>

TEXT:
<merged clause text>

[BASE]
The Receiving Party shall keep Confidential Information confidential for 2 years after termination.

[LEFT]
The Receiving Party shall keep Confidential Information confidential for 3 years after termination.

[RIGHT]
The Receiving Party shall keep Confidential Information confidential for 2 years after termination, except for trade secrets which remain confidential as long as they remain trade secrets.

REASONING:
RIGHT preserves the 2-year term and adds a trade secret carve-out, which is common and does not conflict with BASE.

TEXT:
The Receiving Party shall keep Confidential Information confidential for 2 years after termination, except for trade secrets which remain confidential as long as they remain trade secrets.
You merge contract clauses.

You are reviewing a clause conflict.
Return recommendations only. Do not rewrite the clause.
Format exactly:
RECOMMENDATIONS:
<bulleted or numbered guidance>

[BASE]
The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to its Representatives who have a need to know.

[LEFT]
The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to its Representatives who have a need to know and who are bound by confidentiality obligations.

[RIGHT]
The Receiving Party shall not disclose Confidential Information to any third parties.

RECOMMENDATIONS:
1) Clarify that disclosures to Representatives are permitted if they are under confidentiality obligations.
2) Treat Representatives as permitted recipients and keep the general third-party prohibition for others.
3) Ensure the clause defines Representatives to avoid ambiguity.

Return an alert decision and reason.
Format exactly:
ALERT:
<yes/no>
REASON:
<short reason>

[BASE]
Either party may terminate this agreement upon 10 days' written notice.

[LEFT]
Either party may terminate this agreement upon 30 days' written notice.

[RIGHT]
This agreement is non-terminable and shall remain in effect for 3 years.

ALERT:
yes
REASON:
Termination rights conflict (10 days vs 30 days vs non-terminable).

<short reasoning>

TEXT:

[BASE]
The Receiving Party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information upon the Disclosing Party's written request.

[LEFT]
The Receiving Party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information within 10 business days after the Disclosing Party's written request.

[RIGHT]
The Receiving Party may retain one archival copy solely to demonstrate compliance, subject to ongoing confidentiality obligations.

REASONING:
LEFT adds a timeframe and RIGHT adds a narrow archival copy exception, both compatible with BASE.

TEXT:
The Receiving Party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information within 10 business days after the Disclosing Party's written request, and may retain one archival copy solely to demonstrate compliance, subject to ongoing confidentiality obligations.

[BASE]
This agreement is governed by the laws of [JURISDICTION] without regard to conflict of laws rules.

[LEFT]

[RIGHT]

REASONING:

TEXT:
This agreement is governed by the laws of [JURISDICTION] without regard to conflict of laws rules, and the courts of [JURISDICTION] have exclusive jurisdiction.

You are reviewing a clause conflict.
Return recommendations only. Do not rewrite the clause.
Format exactly:
RECOMMENDATIONS:
<bulleted or numbered guidance>

[BASE]
Each party shall bear its own costs and expenses.

[LEFT]
The Receiving Party shall reimburse the Disclosing Party's reasonable costs and expenses.

[RIGHT]
Each party shall bear its own costs and expenses.

RECOMMENDATIONS:
1) Decide whether cost shifting is intended; LEFT conflicts with BASE/RIGHT.
2) If cost reimbursement is required, scope it (e.g., only diligence costs) and define reasonableness.
3) Otherwise, keep the mutual cost-bearing language.
